definitions.explanation: A flash of light in the sky during a storm.

examples.japanese: {雷|かみなり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}っている→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{雷|かみなり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of thunder in the distance.

examples.japanese: {雷|かみなり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{怖|こわ}くて→怖い：00864_kowai⟧、⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧。
examples.english: I was scared of the thunder and hid under the covers.

examples.japanese: {雷|かみなり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
{雷|かみなり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}った→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。

⟦{急|きゅう}に→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}く→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧{雷|かみなり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}り→光る：01163_hikaru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→～始める：18370_hajimeru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The sky suddenly got dark and lightning started flashing, so I hurried home.

notes:
{雷|かみなり} covers both thunder (the sound) and lightning (the flash). Japanese does not typically distinguish between them the way English does.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧ (god) + ⟦{鳴|な}り→鳴り：noentry⟧ (rumbling) — "the rumbling of the gods."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {雷|かみなり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: thunder rumbles
- {雷|かみなり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: lightning flashes
- {雷|かみなり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: lightning strikes (literally); also: to get yelled at severely

USAGE:
- {雷|かみなり}⟦{親父|おやじ}→おやじ：10249_oyaji⟧: a strict, quick-tempered father
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雷|かみなり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: the teacher blew up at someone

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{落雷|らくらい}→落雷：07379_rakurai⟧: lightning strike
- ⟦{雷雨|らいう}→雷雨：15922_raiu⟧: thunderstorm
- ⟦{雷鳴|らいめい}→雷鳴：06188_raimei⟧: thunder (literary)
